sentences.text:
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
June 12, 2024 13 Ardr Crr 2151 of 2024 Sailendra Shaw & ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & anr. Adv. Ayan Bhattacharjee, Adv. Shounak Mondal, Adv. Suman
Majumder, Adv. Megha Shaw, ... for the petitioners.

The proceeding being G.R. case no. 3083 of 2024 under Sections 420/406 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas is assailed by the petitioner on three fold grounds:-
There has been considerable unexplained delay in lodging the complaint, the provisions under Section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has not been complied with prior to filing the complaint under Section 156(3) of the Code and the matter pertains to dispute between the partners of a partnership firm which has been criminalised by way of filing the present application.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It prima facie appears that the petitioners and the 2 nd opposite party are partners in the partnership firm which is still in vogue.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Since investigation of the matter is in progress, this Court is inclined to hold, upon perusal of the materials on record, that investigation shall proceed in accordance with law.
No coercive action be taken against the petitioners in connection with the proceeding till 31st August, 2024.
Let the matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" on 22nd August, 2024.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
